description.en:
The type of the ClientKey. Valid value:

- **DEVICE**: The key is a device ID.

description.zh: 绑定的Tag，多个Tag用逗号分隔，系统总共支持1万个Tag，此接口一次最多能解绑10个Tag。长度限制：不大于128字符。
description.en: Specifies the tag to unbind. To unbind multiple tags, separate them with commas. A maximum of 10 tags, each up to 128 characters long, can be unbound per request. The system supports a total of 10,000 tags.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun push unbind-tag --app-key 23267207 --client-key e2ba19de97604f55b165576730000 --key-type DEVICE --tag-name test_tag1,test_tag2 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun push UnbindTag --region cn-hangzhou --KeyType DEVICE --TagName 'test_tag1,test_tag2' --AppKey 23267207 --ClientKey e2ba19de97604f55b165576730000
